This verifies the interface only, not independent review or acceptance.

The current draft A page, alg-multinomial-and-residual-offspring-resampling, and thm-multinomial-and-residual-resampling-have-unbiased-offspring-counts were inspected in full. The algorithm defines finite categorical multinomial/residual offspring counts and a zero-weight fallback; the theorem proves only the conditional expected-count identity. The local SMC update uses its multinomial ancestor counts and conditional expectation and makes no claim that a normalized finite-particle estimate is unbiased. This verifies the used interface only, not independent review or acceptance.

Its exact interface assumes standard-Borel parameter and data spaces, prior probability Pi, simulator probability kernel K, measurable S into R^d, observed summary s0, and epsilon>=0; it defines the tolerance ball, prior-predictive event probability p_epsilon, and assigns the ABC parameter target only when p_epsilon>0. It identifies that target as the parameter law conditional on the tolerance event. The local augmented target uses these same objects and adds the full joint (theta,Y) law through the published prior-kernel joint-law lemma. The BCS-24 item remains a draft; this is interface verification, not approval.
